_doc: Custom pixel cursor (src/game/cursor/cursorArt.ts paints it, src/ui/GameCursor.tsx shows it). `arrow` is the Demon Lord's obsidian claw-arrow with an ember at its tip (16x16, hotspot = its tip at 0,0); every state is painted from it in code: idle (ember flicker), hover (pulsing aether glow), press (pressed in + spark burst), grab (dragging the map), disabled (grey + no-sign). `target` (sky-laser reticle, over the map during a battle) and `wait` (spinning rune circle, loading) are drawn in code too. `scale` = screen pixels per art pixel; `fps` = frames per second per state.
